# Data Cleaning

::: panel-tabset


## Sessions

```{r}
# read in data
FLE <- readMat("data/FLE_Values.mat") # https://osf.io/s4aqg/overview

# data wrangling
overallOfBothSessions<- FLE$FLE.Overall
overallOfBothSessions<- as_tibble(overallOfBothSessions)

sess1JoV <-  as_tibble(FLE$FLE.Sess1) # n=85
sess2JoV <-  as_tibble(FLE$FLE.Sess2) # n = 85

sess1JoV <- sess1JoV |>
  rename(
    ID     = V1,
    pixels = V2,
    dva    = V3
  )

sess2JoV <- sess2JoV |>
  rename(
    ID     = V1,
    pixels = V2,
    dva    = V3
  )

sess1JoV$session <- 1
sess2JoV$session <- 2

myOverallJoV <- rbind(sess1JoV, sess2JoV)

# check for na and duplicates (none)
anyNA(myOverallJoV)
any(duplicated(sess1JoV$ID))
any(duplicated(sess2JoV$ID))

# save as csv for future
write_csv(myOverallJoV, "Cottier2023_2Sessions.csv")
```


## Staircases

```{r}
# # if zipped, run this or unzip manually
# unzip(
#   zipfile = "data/Cottier2023.zip",
#   exdir = "data"
# )

# Folder containing all participant-session CSV files
# data_folder <- "data/Cottier2023" # unzip!
data_folder <- "/Users/imanelattab/Desktop/Cottier2023/FLE_Raw"

# Number used in the original MATLAB processing:
# tail(..., AVOVER + 1) means the final 21 trials
AVOVER <- 20
n_trials_to_average <- AVOVER + 1

# Convert pixels to degrees of visual angle
tc_dva <- function(x, screen_distance = 500) {

  screen_width <- 543.7  # mm
  resolution_x <- 1920

  pixel_width <- screen_width / resolution_x

  atan((x * pixel_width) / screen_distance) * 180 / pi
}

# Convert displacement in degrees of polar angle to DVA
polar_deg_to_dva <- function(x, radius_px = 380) {

  tangential_displacement_px <- x * radius_px * pi / 180

  tc_dva(tangential_displacement_px)
}

# Process one participant-session CSV file
process_fle_file <- function(file_path) {

  # Extract participant ID and session number from filename
  #
  # Example:
  # DID_FLE_1_2.csv
  # Participant ID = 1
  # Session = 2
  file_info <- str_match(
    basename(file_path),
    "^DID_FLE_([0-9]+)_([0-9]+)\\.csv$"
  )

  participant_id <- as.integer(file_info[, 2])
  session_number <- as.integer(file_info[, 3])

  # Stop if the filename does not have the expected format
  if (is.na(participant_id) || is.na(session_number)) {
    warning("Could not extract ID/session from: ", basename(file_path))
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Read and clean the data
  fle <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    filter(Prac != "Yes")

  # Function to calculate the PSE for one staircase
calculate_staircase_pse <- function(data, stair_number, stair_column) {

  staircase_values <- data |>
    filter(StairNum == stair_number) |>
    pull({{ stair_column }})

  # Remove missing values from the numeric vector
  staircase_values <- staircase_values[!is.na(staircase_values)]

  if (length(staircase_values) == 0) {
    warning(
      "Participant ", participant_id,
      ", session ", session_number,
      ", staircase ", stair_number,
      " contains no valid observations."
    )

    return(NA_real_)
  }

  if (length(staircase_values) < n_trials_to_average) {
    warning(
      "Participant ", participant_id,
      ", session ", session_number,
      ", staircase ", stair_number,
      " has only ", length(staircase_values),
      " non-missing trials."
    )
  }

  mean(
    tail(staircase_values, n_trials_to_average),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}

  # Raw staircase PSEs
  ST1_PSE <- calculate_staircase_pse(fle, 1, Stair1)
  ST2_PSE <- calculate_staircase_pse(fle, 2, Stair2)
  ST3_PSE <- calculate_staircase_pse(fle, 3, Stair3)
  ST4_PSE <- calculate_staircase_pse(fle, 4, Stair4)

  # Return one row per staircase
  tibble(
    ID = participant_id,
    session = session_number,
    staircase = 1:4,
    direction = c("CW", "CW", "CCW", "CCW"),
    PSE_deg = c(
      ST1_PSE,
      ST2_PSE,
      ST3_PSE,
      ST4_PSE
    )
  ) |>
    mutate(
      # Reverse the sign for counterclockwise staircases so that
      # positive values consistently indicate a positive FLE
      FLE_deg = if_else(
        direction == "CCW",
        -PSE_deg,
        PSE_deg
      ),

      FLE_dva = polar_deg_to_dva(FLE_deg),

      source_file = basename(file_path)
    )
}

# Find all files matching the expected naming convention

# Check that the folder exists
if (!dir.exists(data_folder)) {
  stop("Folder does not exist: ", data_folder)
}

# Find matching CSV files
fle_files <- list.files(
  path = data_folder,
  pattern = "^DID_FLE_[0-9]+_[0-9]+\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

message("Matching files found: ", length(fle_files))

if (length(fle_files) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "No matching files found. Check the folder and filenames. ",
    "Expected filenames such as DID_FLE_1_2.csv."
  )
}

# Process and combine files
all_staircase_FLEs <- map_dfr(
  fle_files,
  process_fle_file
)

if (nrow(all_staircase_FLEs) == 0L) {
  stop("Files were found, but processing returned no rows.")
}

all_staircase_FLEs <- all_staircase_FLEs |>
  arrange(ID, session, staircase)

print(all_staircase_FLEs)

# Save combined dataset
output_path <- file.path(
  data_folder,
  "all_participants_staircase_FLEs.csv"
)

write_csv(all_staircase_FLEs, output_path)

message("Combined dataset saved to: ", output_path)
```



## Read in Sessions

```{r}
# 2 sessions (2 repeated measures)
myOverallJoV <- read.csv("data/Cottier2023/Cottier2023_2Sessions.csv") # UNZIP!

# ID and session as categorical
myOverallJoV <- myOverallJoV |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    ID = factor(ID),
    session = factor(session)
  )
```


## Read in Staircases

```{r}
# 8 staircases (8 repeated measures)
all_staircase_FLEs <- read.csv("data/Cottier2023/FLE_Raw/all_participants_staircase_FLEs.csv") # UNZIP!

# ID, session, and staircase as categorical
all_staircase_FLEs <- all_staircase_FLEs |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    ID = factor(ID),
    session = factor(session),
    staircase = factor(staircase)
  )
```
